About Me

I am an offensive security consultant and certified penetration tester based in Fes, Morocco. With over five years of hands-on experience across red teaming, Active Directory exploitation, and web application security, I specialize in identifying and exploiting complex vulnerabilities in enterprise environments.

Holding certifications from Hack The Box, INE Security, Altered Security, Zero Point Security, and Cyber Warfare Labs, I bring both theoretical depth and practical expertise to every engagement. My methodology aligns with industry frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, enabling structured, high-fidelity adversary simulation.

Currently pursuing an engineering degree in cybersecurity at SUP MTI Rabat, I remain committed to continuous learning and pushing the boundaries of offensive security research.
